email.body1:
Matthew, saw VertexOne raised $131M and is expanding its utility CX footprint with new go-lives like Discount Power.

Growth like that usually means more co-sell motion than partner teams can cover by hand, and partner-sourced pipeline quietly stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across your partner ecosystem on its own, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for VertexOne's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for VertexOne.

As the channel scales, partner-sourced pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many co-sell meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and our pipeline model, showing exactly how many partner meetings VertexOne needs, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for VertexOne.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your partner reply rate likely compares to other utility-tech channel teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling co-sell pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything after a raise, and standing up channel motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner ecosystem? I'll tailor it to VertexOne either way.
